quote: should be a dependency-closed composition release around the Semantic Manufacturing checkpoint, not an “all repositories green” release.
statement: Chatman Ecosystem v26.9.23 is a dependency-closed composition release around the Semantic Manufacturing checkpoint, not an all-repositories-green release.

quote: There is not yet an admitted `chatman-ecosystem v26.9.23` subject, and the upstream Semantic Manufacturing crown is not yet complete.
statement: No admitted chatman-ecosystem v26.9.23 subject exists and the upstream Semantic Manufacturing crown is not complete.

quote: GitHub branch still contains an older `STOP=false`, `0/13` receipt
statement: The pushed xaas branch still carries a stale STOP=false 0/13 receipt that is not admissible as the final crown.

quote: Therefore the local 11/13 result must be re-sealed rather than treated as already published standing.
statement: The local 11/13 Semantic Manufacturing court result is re-sealed from court output before it is used, never treated as already published standing.

quote: qualify exact integration heads → stop court → PRs → exact-head CI/fix-forward → merge → independently verify → requalify main → release receipt → tag only after reproducible `STOP=true`
statement: The Semantic Manufacturing release proceeds in order: qualify exact integration heads, stop court, PRs, exact-head CI with fix-forward, merge, independent verification, requalify main, release receipt, and tag only after reproducible STOP=true.

quote: `chatman-ecosystem` working subject is bound to a GitHub remote + exact SHA; lineage is proven rather than inferred
statement: The chatman-ecosystem working subject is bound to a GitHub remote and an exact SHA, and its lineage is proven rather than inferred.

quote: Overnight fleet classified the local checkout `UNSUPPORTED` because it could not relate it to published GitHub lineage
statement: The overnight fleet classified the local chatman-ecosystem checkout UNSUPPORTED because it could not relate it to published GitHub lineage.

quote: Add `release/v26.9.23/…`
statement: An independent release/v26.9.23 subject is added to chatman-ecosystem.

quote: preserve `release/v26.9.1` untouched
statement: The release/v26.9.1 subject of chatman-ecosystem is preserved untouched.

quote: Every one of the 16 roles required by `release/v26.9.1/manifest.toml` maps explicitly to `REQUIRED`, `SUCCESSOR`, `BLOCKED`, `UNSUPPORTED`, or `REFUSED` for the new boundary
statement: Every one of the 16 roles required by release/v26.9.1/manifest.toml maps explicitly to REQUIRED, SUCCESSOR, BLOCKED, UNSUPPORTED or REFUSED for the v26.9.23 boundary.

quote: Must not silently erase the old release topology
statement: The old v26.9.1 release topology is never silently erased.

quote: The existing `chatman-ecosystem` manifest for `v26.9.1` has **16 required roles**
statement: The v26.9.1 chatman-ecosystem manifest has 16 required roles, from public ontology to capstone.

quote: They *are* contradictory if we simply replace the old 16-role manifest with a two-repo manifest and pretend the old obligations disappeared.
statement: Replacing the old 16-role manifest with a two-repo manifest that pretends the old obligations disappeared falsifies the boundary crosswalk.

quote: ReleaseGraph_{23}
statement: The v26.9.23 release graph consists of the Chatman root, the Semantic Manufacturing crown, the fleet classification and the legacy role crosswalk.

quote: with only the subjects actually required by the v26.9.23 checkpoint participating in its conjunctive runtime crown.
statement: Only the subjects actually required by the v26.9.23 checkpoint participate in the conjunctive runtime crown.

quote: Exact digest of a fresh `STOP-GC-26.9.23` receipt says `STOP=true`, all 13 gate receipts admitted, replay succeeds
statement: The exact digest of a fresh STOP-GC-26.9.23 receipt says STOP=true, all 13 Semantic Manufacturing gate receipts are admitted, and replay succeeds.

quote: 11/13 observed; pushed STOP receipt stale
statement: 11 of 13 Semantic Manufacturing gates were observed ALIVE and the pushed STOP receipt is stale.

quote: SM\_STOP=\bigwedge_{i=0}^{12}GC23_i
statement: SM_STOP is the conjunction of the Semantic Manufacturing gates GC23-0 through GC23-12.

quote: V23-H manufactures successor prose; its digest is explicitly accepted; self-hosting court passes
statement: V23-H manufactures successor prose, its digest is explicitly accepted, and the GC23-12 self-hosting court passes.

quote: operator successor-digest acceptance
statement: Acceptance of the successor digest is an operator act on the critical path.

quote: V23-H unfinished; `successor/ACCEPTED` absent
statement: V23-H was unfinished and successor/ACCEPTED was absent when the prose was written.

quote: `xaas` and `ggen_igniter` release changes reach exact post-merge `main` SHAs; fleet receipts are regenerated against those identities
statement: The xaas and ggen_igniter release changes reach exact post-merge main SHAs and the fleet receipts are regenerated against those identities.

quote: Both branches remain off main; no PRs
statement: Both critical release branches remain off main with no PRs open.

quote: Every observed repo is classified; `RequiredUnknown=0`; `UnclassifiedRequiredWork=0`; noncritical failures cannot reopen the release without falsifying a GC23 proposition
statement: Every observed repository is classified, RequiredUnknown is 0, UnclassifiedRequiredWork is 0, and noncritical failures cannot reopen the release without falsifying a GC23 proposition.

quote: Existing 21-repo matrix supplies the starting projection
statement: The existing 21-repository fleet matrix supplies the starting projection of the fleet classification.

quote:
FleetClosed \iff
RequiredUnknown=0
\land UnclassifiedRequiredWork=0.
statement: FleetClosed holds iff RequiredUnknown = 0 and UnclassifiedRequiredWork = 0.

quote: **Critical path:** `xaas`, `ggen_igniter`.
statement: xaas and ggen_igniter are the critical path of the v26.9.23 release.

quote: **Successor:** `ash_a2a`, `ash_atlassian`, `ash_surface`, `autofde-lab`, `beam4pm`, `engineering-standards`, `ferroplan`, `frozen-duckdb`, `ggen`, `ggen-marketplace`, `gitvan`, `gymact`, `open-ontologies`, `zcode-cli`.
statement: ash_a2a, ash_atlassian, ash_surface, autofde-lab, beam4pm, engineering-standards, ferroplan, frozen-duckdb, ggen, ggen-marketplace, gitvan, gymact, open-ontologies and zcode-cli are Successor for this release.

quote: **Blocked but noncritical:** `ggen-ecosystem`.
statement: ggen-ecosystem is Blocked but noncritical for this release.

quote: **Refused from this release boundary:** `remo`, `turbo-fieldfare`, `unjucks`.
statement: remo, turbo-fieldfare and unjucks are Refused from this release boundary.

quote: v26.9.23 therefore needs to repair **transport/identity**, not “fix” Chatman implementation code merely because of that classification.
statement: Chatman implementation code is not changed merely because the local checkout was classified UNSUPPORTED; v26.9.23 repairs transport and identity only.

quote: “making every repository ALIVE” is not a release requirement.
statement: Making every repository ALIVE is not a v26.9.23 release requirement.

quote: WD FA/V23-W should also **not** become a new v26.9.23 blocker.
statement: WD FA and V23-W do not become a v26.9.23 blocker; live WD integration is excluded from this release.

quote: Do **not** spend v26.9.23 closing `ggen-ecosystem`, `autofde-lab`, `ash_surface`, `zcode-cli`, or other successor work unless an observation proves one of those repos is actually traversed by a GC23 court.
statement: v26.9.23 spends no work closing ggen-ecosystem, autofde-lab, ash_surface, zcode-cli or other successor work unless an observation proves a GC23 court traverses that repository.

quote: That would change the topology; until then, it is successor work by construction.
statement: Work on successor repositories is successor work by construction until an observation changes the topology.

quote: `verify_release`, portfolio survey/planner, standing verifier, West projection, etc. can explicitly target `release/v26.9.23` rather than silently defaulting to `v26.9.1`
statement: verify_release, the portfolio survey and planner, the standing verifier, the West projection and the other Chatman tooling can explicitly target release/v26.9.23 rather than silently defaulting to v26.9.1.

quote: Multiple current scripts/catalog surfaces default to `release/v26.9.1/...`
statement: Multiple current Chatman scripts and catalog surfaces default to release/v26.9.1.

quote: Imported crown proves `LLM_INVOCATIONS_ON_KNOWN_REFERENCE_PATH=0` and `UNRECEIPTED_ACTUATION=0`
statement: The imported Semantic Manufacturing crown proves LLM_INVOCATIONS_ON_KNOWN_REFERENCE_PATH=0 and UNRECEIPTED_ACTUATION=0.

quote: Must be carried into root release receipt, not merely documented
statement: The zero-LLM and zero-unreceipted-actuation evidence is carried into the root release receipt, not merely documented.

quote: Candidate Chatman SHA passes generated-projection drift, manifest/ref validation, unit/integration, imported receipt validation, replay, and strict release crown
statement: The candidate Chatman SHA passes generated-projection drift, manifest and ref validation, unit and integration tests, imported receipt validation, replay and the strict release crown.

quote: Not manufactured yet
statement: The exact-head root court was not manufactured when the prose was written.

quote: Receipt binds Chatman SHA, xaas SHA, ggen_igniter SHA, graph/ontology/schema/toolchain/provider digests, fleet digest, all gate receipts, replay and exclusions
statement: The root release receipt binds the Chatman, xaas and ggen_igniter SHAs, the graph, ontology, schema, toolchain and provider digests, the fleet digest, all gate receipts, replay and exclusions.

quote: `v26.9.23` identifies the exact Chatman release whose imported Semantic Manufacturing STOP replays true
statement: The v26.9.23 tag identifies the exact Chatman release whose imported Semantic Manufacturing STOP replays true.

quote: Impossible until CE23-3…10 close
statement: The v26.9.23 tag is impossible until CE23-3 through CE23-10 close.

quote:
CHATMAN\_STOP_{26.9.23}
=
Identity
\land BoundaryCrosswalk
\land SM\_STOP
\land ExactMainHeads
\land FleetClosed
\land KnownPath_{LLM=0}
\land UnreceiptedActuation_{=0}
\land Replay
\land RootReceipt
statement: The root court computes CHATMAN_STOP = Identity ∧ BoundaryCrosswalk ∧ SM_STOP ∧ ExactMainHeads ∧ FleetClosed ∧ KnownPath_LLM=0 ∧ UnreceiptedActuation=0 ∧ Replay ∧ RootReceipt.

quote: **V23-H → operator successor-digest acceptance → fresh 12/13 court → V23-Q release lane → PR both critical repos → exact-head CI/fix-forward → merge → requalify → GC23-11 → fresh 13/13 `STOP=true` receipt → manufacture `chatman-ecosystem/release/v26.9.23` → crosswalk old roles → root crown/replay → tag.**
statement: The critical path runs V23-H, operator successor-digest acceptance, a fresh 12/13 court, the V23-Q release lane, PRs of both critical repos, exact-head CI with fix-forward, merge, requalification, GC23-11, a fresh 13/13 STOP=true receipt, manufacture of chatman-ecosystem/release/v26.9.23, the old-role crosswalk, root crown and replay, then the tag.
